# Method GetUserName

#### GetUserName(string, out string, out string, out string)

Gets the name of a user.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 11, 300, 80)]
void GetUserName(string inAccountId, out string outFirstName, out string outLastName, out string outInitials)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  string |  inAccountId |  User account identifier.  |  
 
|  string |  outFirstName |  User first name.  |  
 
|  string |  outLastName |  User last name.  |  
 
|  string |  outInitials |  User initials.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.10.
